text:
Marcus: Heads-up — sharing the company-level OKR draft for FY26. Need alignment on tradeoffs between latency SLOs vs. go-to-market features. Read here: https://docs.redwood.ai/okrs/fy26-draft and drop comments. Asking for exec sign-off by EOD Friday.

Priya: Quick q — the latency/throughput KR lists `99th latency < 120ms`. Is that hosted-only or Dedicated too? We should be explicit for quantized/rolled-out models.

Sam: That should be across hosted + dedicated. If hardware differences make it infeasible, add an exception like 'applies to standard-serving variants; see appendix for special-case regions'. Also recommend moving 'quantization rollout' from stretch → committed given cost upside.

Lina: From GTM: customers frequently ask for Private deployment SLAs. Can we add a revenue-linked KR, e.g., `Booked ARR influenced by Private >= $2.5M`? That helps prioritization for sales motions. :eyes: 

Jorge: For launch criteria, suggest a short checklist in the doc: `docs + runbook + canary for top 10 orgs + acceptance test set`. CC @Priya for the acceptance tests.

Priya: Agree on acceptance tests. Also propose we soft-pedal multi-region full rollout — change to 'pilot in one additional region' until Dedicated autoscaling is stable. That infra lift is big.

Marcus: Proposed edits I will make:
```
- Move quantization to committed KRs
- Add Private ARR KR = $2.5M placeholder
- Change multi-region to 'pilot in 1 additional region'
```
Any objections?

Sam: No objections. One ask: include an explicit rollback policy for quantization: `automatic fallback to full-precision if perf regression > 5% on top-line evals`.

Lina: $2.5M placeholder sounds fine, will validate with the deal pipeline and update before EOD Friday.

Jorge: I'll update the launch checklist and add the canary playbook to the doc. Will ping when done.

Marcus: Great. If everyone's aligned I'll publish final draft Friday 17:00 PST and circulate to board. Please add quick reactions as sign-off. :thumbsup: :rocket:

Priya: Sign-off from Platform.

Sam: Sign-off from Eng Infra.

Lina: Sign-off from GTM.

Jorge: Sign-off from Product Ops.

OpsBot: deployment-bot reminder — scheduled publish: 2025-03-14T17:00Z if no manual override.

Marcus: Thanks all — closing thread. If anyone needs a different number or wants to escalate a risk, ping me directly.
